session-file-snapshot-seam.title: Session file-snapshot seam
session-file-snapshot-seam.problem: dsh sessions persist a jsonl/sqlite projection; there is no per-prompt snapshot store of edited files to anchor a rewind against.
session-file-snapshot-seam.cc_contract: Every prompt checkpoints files about to be edited; /rewind (or Esc Esc) restores code, conversation, or both; checkpoints persist across resumed sessions and do not cover Bash-side changes.

schedule-cron-selector.title: Cron-expression selector for dsh-schedule
schedule-cron-selector.problem: dsh-schedule supports after_seconds / at / every_seconds (>=300s) but has no cron-expression selector, so ScheduleCronTool parity is unreachable.
schedule-cron-selector.cc_contract: Claude Code scheduled reminders accept cron expressions as selectors.

webfetch-ssrf-allowlist.title: SSRF host allowlist for web-fetch-http
webfetch-ssrf-allowlist.problem: The web-fetch-http executor row is unshipped by the CLI through 0.1.1-rc.2 and there is no host allowlist, so WebFetch stays enable-only-on-egress-restricted-deployments.
webfetch-ssrf-allowlist.cc_contract: Claude Code WebFetch enforces an SSRF allowlist before honoring fetches.

precompact-seam.title: PreCompact interception seam in dsh-compaction
precompact-seam.problem: dsh-compaction has no interception point where a user-configured hook could run before compaction fires, so the PreCompact event cannot bridge.
precompact-seam.cc_contract: Claude Code fires PreCompact hooks before automatic or manual compaction, letting hooks inject or transform context.

tasks-todo-seam.title: Human-facing todo-list seam for /tasks
tasks-todo-seam.problem: dsh-tool-todo is model-facing and the TUI renders the todo panel, but human-facing /tasks still lists background jobs only.
tasks-todo-seam.cc_contract: Claude Code's /tasks surfaces the session todo list to the human user.

memory-fsinfo-mtime.title: Memory freshness — FsInfo mtime seam
memory-fsinfo-mtime.problem: CC threads mtimeMs through recall and ages memories (memoryAge); the current dsh-fs seam does not expose mtime, so both are deferred.
memory-fsinfo-mtime.cc_contract: Claude Code memory recall orders by file mtime and exposes a memoryAge signal so stale memories age out of prominence.

notification-seam.title: Notification seam in deepseek-harness
notification-seam.problem: No notification seam exists in deepseek-harness (bell/OS/iterm); shipping notifications needs a new design.
notification-seam.cc_contract: Claude Code emits desktop/terminal notifications for attention-needed moments (bell, OS notification, iTerm2 escape sequences).

permission-mode-catalog-pin.title: Upstream catalog pin of permission/mode session events
permission-mode-catalog-pin.problem: The plugin registers permission/mode into KNOWN_SESSION_EVENT_TYPES via a runtime Set.add at load; bumping the harness's own compiled catalog is an upstream polish.
permission-mode-catalog-pin.cc_contract: Permission-mode session state persists across process restarts, not just within the registering process.

upstream-issue-2124.title: Upstream harness issue
upstream-issue-2124.problem: Fork children remain foreground one-shot until upstream harness issue #2124 resolves; fork + run_in_background is rejected with an error naming the issue.
upstream-issue-2124.cc_contract: Claude Code Task supports the fork provider in continuable background mode with the same agentId-addressable loop as spawn.

Deliberate deviations: fork + background is rejected naming upstream issue #2124 (fork stays foreground one-shot); no TaskOutput alias and no outputFile field; omitting run_in_background stays foreground unless the definition pins background: true, unlike Claude Code's interactive omit=background. Continuable cold resume: each background spawn captures a resume pin (resolveDetailed-selected alias plus maxTokens) into the resumePinStore service (preset row cc-resume-pins, isolated as resumePinStore in cc-services), and resume restores the pinned tuple INCLUDING explicit absence (a pin recording an unset reasoningEffort/maxTokens is honored as absent rather than re-resolved); a pinned model the parent can no longer resolve is gated by the subagents-resume settings namespace (subagents-resume.onUnavailableModel: block|route-current, default block) with deny codes SUBAGENT_MODEL_UNAVAILABLE / WORKSPACE_CHANGED / DEFINITION_CHANGED / PINNED_TOOL_UNAVAILABLE / PIN_ORPHANED / PIN_UNREADABLE naming the policy knob — Claude Code has no equivalent mechanism.
